message:
Merge pull request #90 from orhun/master

Update Arch Linux installation instructions

pr.title: Update Arch Linux installation instructions
pr.body:
Hey!

`ali` is now availabe in the Arch Linux community repository: https://archlinux.org/packages/community/x86_64/ali/
(AUR packages will be deleted soon.)
This PR basically updates the installation instructions for Arch Linux. (8f9d05a)

BR,
orhun.

diff:
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
index 78b7e6b..879bc5d 100644
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -32,11 +32,10 @@ apt install ./ali_0.5.4_linux_amd64.deb
 rpm -ivh https://github.com/nakabonne/ali/releases/download/v0.5.4/ali_0.5.4_linux_amd64.rpm
 ```
 
-**Via AUR**
+**Via Pacman**
 
-Thanks to [orhun](https://github.com/orhun), it's available as [ali](https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/ali) in the Arch User Repository.
 ```bash
-yay -S ali
+pacman -S ali
 ```
 
 **Via Go**
